rationale.quality-debt: Documents architectural entropy, maintainability burden, testing gaps, and deployment fragility.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Scanning seven vibe-coded MVPs found 970 concrete security issues.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Rapid regeneration repeatedly outpaced architects, testers, and human review capacity.
rationale.automation-bias: Polished outputs and passing mock-based tests created false confidence and disengagement.
rationale.ai-review: Uses agentic security scanning and advocates supplementary AI evaluation agents.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Recommends tests, linting, type checks, SAST, DAST, and CI gates.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines approval permissions, senior-review checkpoints, sign-offs, and human audits.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Attribution, visualization, and semantic differences support judging generated changes.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Generated features exceeded requirements; semantic differencing exposes intent-level departures.
rationale.org-governance: Proposes accountability roles, approval policies, audit trails, and workforce training.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps compliance checks and audit evidence to GDPR, ISO, and standards.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires persistent prompt, model-version, parameter, approval, and IP-lineage records.
